notes:
- New built-in add-on Game Assets (off by default, turn it on in Settings › Add-ons): trim and resize sprites (power of two, shared frame for animations), sprite atlases with Godot SpriteFrames / TexturePacker data, slicing sprite sheets, packing PBR channels (ORM, HDRP / URP masks), converting to DDS (BC1–BC7), checking textures before export
- Add-ons can now read and write image pixels (images.read / info / write) – see the add-on guide
- Small fixes (English keyboard hint in the sidebar)
